In this topsy-turvy world, the ancient Greeks had traded in their togas for trendy, three-piece suits, their iconic Parthenon now a gleaming, glass-and-steel skyscraper that seemed to defy gravity. The once-mighty Egyptians had donned designer duds, their pyramids now towering, trapezoidal skyscrapers that seemed to stretch on forever.

In the midst of this bizarre, bewildering world, a group of brave, brilliant archaeologists set out to unravel the mysteries of this strange, new world. As they dug deeper, they discovered that the Flip had occurred in a burst of brilliant, blinding light, which had simultaneously transported the aesthetics of the ancient civilizations to the modern world, and vice versa. The once-ancient Greeks were now the masters of modern technology, while the modern world was awash in classical, curvilinear beauty.

The team's research led them to a hidden, high-tech laboratory deep beneath the streets of New Atlantis, where they encountered a brilliant, brilliant scientist named Dr. Maximilian Murchison. A master of the mysterious, mystical "Flip," Dr. Murchison revealed to the team that the Flip was not a random event, but rather a deliberate, calculated act of cosmic engineering.

According to Dr. Murchison, the Flip had been orchestrated by a secret society of brilliant, brilliant minds who had sought to create a new, utopian world order.
